purpose.domain_detail: ACAS (Applewood Computers Accounting System) - a multi-module accounting system covering IRS (Integrated Revenue System/ledgers), Sales, Purchase, Stock, General, Payroll, EPOS, Order Entry
purpose.summary: This is the main menu/control program for the ACAS accounting system. It initialises the environment, checks terminal dimensions, reads or creates the system parameter file, and dispatches to sub-systems (IRS, Sales, Purchase, Stock, General, etc.) via CALL statements. It also handles first-time setup of parameter files and data tables.

notable_features: COPY with REPLACING for wssystem.cob (extensive field renaming)
14 COPY statements for modular copybook architecture
GOTO used for terminal-size retry loops
verdict.notes: Source truncated at 16000 chars (full file is 26552 bytes, 757 lines). The program is clearly a real production accounting system with extensive version history, copyright notices, and modular architecture. No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS present despite RDB mentions - uses COBOL file I/O. Comment ratio is very high (50%) due to extensive documentation headers.
